card: This PR adds block serving and downloading for BIP 332 Stale Tip Relay via a new -staletips=blocks mode. Header-only relay informs nodes of stale forks but prevents inspection of their block data, while standard block download risks disconnecting peers if intermediate unvalidated blocks are unavailable. Stale-branch blocks are retrieved backward from the tip using an isolated, best-effort scheduler with tailored peer misbehavior rules. This change depends on PR 36920 and completes the protocol implementation for tracking issue 36833.
changed_since_previous: The previous description was generated without a diff. With the diff available, the specific mechanism for best-effort download (starting at the tip, limiting in-flight blocks to 8 per peer, and isolating timeout/failure handling from standard peer bans) is confirmed.
evidence: PR description: fixes peer disconnections from handling higher-work stale tips through normal block download, which 'expected every ancestor from that peer and could disconnect it'
Commit bf6e9f62a5: 'Send the manager's best-effort requests instead. If one times out, we move on without disconnecting anyone, and normal block download can still fetch the same block'
Part of tracking issue #36833 implementing BIP 332
problem: Header-only stale tip relay informs nodes about reorged tips but leaves them unable to inspect block transactions on stale branches. Passing stale blocks or higher-work stale tips through standard initial block download risks disconnecting peers because normal sync expects every missing ancestor and penalizes invalid blocks, whereas BIP 332 peers only promise having the tip and may relay blocks without having validated their scripts.

risk.why: Flaws in custom block request scheduling or serving limit checks could lead to P2P stalls, peer bandwidth exhaustion, or incorrect peer disconnections.

scope_notes: This PR is stacked on PR 36920 (and transitively PR 36919), containing commits from both bases. The new commits specific to this PR start from 'refactor: extract block serving limit checks'. Over half of the diff consists of unit and functional tests.
summary: Implements block serving and fetching for BIP 332 Stale Tip Relay on top of header-only stale tip relay. It introduces the `-staletips=blocks` option, which advertises block preference to peers and downloads blocks along offered stale branches. Downloads operate on a dedicated, best-effort schedule separate from standard block sync, requesting blocks backward from the tip to avoid disconnecting peers when unvalidated ancestors are missing.
